description: This source file defines a Dart class 'NoteDatabaseService' which manages local SQLite database operations for notes, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes using the sqflite package.

classes.name: NoteDatabaseService
classes.description: A service class that handles all local database operations related to notes, including CRUD operations and database initialization.

methods.name: database
methods.description: A getter that initializes and provides access to the singleton database instance.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the database, sorted by last updated time in descending order.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns its assigned ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note record in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: _initDB
methods.description: Initializes the SQLite database and creates the 'notes' table if it does not already exist.
